records.Title: S3 bucket permits public read access
records.Description: The customer-uploads bucket policy grants s3:GetObject to all principals.

Recommendation.Text: Enable S3 Block Public Access and replace the public bucket statement with a scoped CloudFront origin access control.

records.Title: IAM root account lacks hardware MFA
records.Description: The AWS account root user is not protected by a hardware MFA device.

Recommendation.Text: Register two FIDO2 security keys for the root user and store them in separate controlled locations.

records.Title: EC2 instance exposes SSH to the internet
records.Description: A security group permits inbound TCP/22 from 0.0.0.0/0.

Recommendation.Text: Remove the public SSH rule and use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager for administrative access.
